bindings.selected_has_route_guard.num_entries: selected parser-reachable HasRouteTlv within networkData.GetTlvs()[0 .. networkData.GetLength()), interpreted as HasRouteTlv::GetNumEntries()
bindings.selected_has_route_guard.copy_src_ptr: selected parser-reachable HasRouteTlv within networkData.GetTlvs()[0 .. networkData.GetLength()), interpreted as HasRouteTlv::GetEntry(0)

note: The vulnerable source has no single named local for the exact Has Route sub-TLV that later becomes the selected AddHasRoute() source. Stage 04 therefore binds selected_has_route_guard.* to a semantic helper view over the real vulnerable HandleServerData expressions networkData.GetTlvs() and networkData.GetLength(): it replays the same Prefix/HasRoute traversal that AddNetworkData() and AddPrefix() perform over that forwarded byte span, preferring the last parser-reachable HasRoute whose GetEntry(0) + sizeof(HasRouteEntry) crosses the forwarded span end and otherwise the last parser-reachable HasRoute. The sink-side has_route_memcpy.* fields are the exact vulnerable AddHasRoute() operands at the memcpy site.
